1.name: Life Drain
1.description: Leech the life force of your target, dealing 3 Corruption Damage and restoring your Health by the same amount.

1.name: Locate Corpse
1.description: Link the soul of your target to its corporeal form, revealing the direction of their corpse in the current zone.

1.name: Minor Unliving Shield
1.description: Raise a shield of unliving energy around yourself, increasing your maximum Health by 10, Armor Class by 5, Magic Resistance by 5, and Holy Resistance by 1 for 1 hour. Soul Tether can't trigger again until 30 seconds after it ends.

1.description: Reclaim the essence of your pet, destroying it and converting 25% of its Health into Mana.

4.name: Gate
